statement: model-based data augmentation improves the horizon dependence to H*[sqrt(log|Pi|/n)+eps_q] without requiring the RTVC assumption.
rtvc_not_required: The model-augmented bound formula contains no RTVC modulus kappa; it holds under P-EIISS alone. The naive bound needs RTVC to avoid the H^2 term, confirming Theorem 7 removes the smoothness requirement.

mutation_test.name: alter algorithm from model-augmented to naive log-loss BC (RTVC still unavailable)
mutation_test.before: model-augmented, no RTVC -> horizon dependence slope 1.00 (linear H*eps_q)
mutation_test.after: naive BC, no RTVC -> horizon dependence slope 2.00 (quadratic H^2)

notes: Verified = the bound formulas confirm the model-augmented method attains a LINEAR H*eps_q quantization horizon-dependence without any RTVC assumption, whereas naive log-loss BC degrades to H^2 once RTVC is unavailable. The mutation (dropping the augmentation while RTVC is absent) restores the H^2 behaviour, breaking the claim -> the improvement is genuinely attributable to the augmentation.
